denominators.extraction_recall: correct required fields extracted / human-labelled supported required fields
denominators.accepted_claim_precision: human-supported accepted material claims / all accepted material claims
denominators.citation_support: accepted claims whose every citation supports the claim / all accepted claims
denominators.numeric_correctness: accepted numeric claims correct in figure, unit, currency, period and scope / all accepted numeric claims
denominators.unsupported_claim_rate: unsupported accepted claims / all accepted claims
denominators.required_abstention_recall: human-labelled insufficient/unsupported cases correctly abstained / all human-labelled cases requiring abstention

maturity: quality acceptance unavailable until labels independently reviewed and protocol approved
confidence_reporting: Report raw counts, denominator, per-error strata and uncertainty; small samples do not establish general financial accuracy.
